project_guidance.title: Welsh outbuilding checks
project_guidance.intro: Use this starting point with the full official guidance and the planning history for your address.
rules: Garden buildings must serve a purpose incidental to the house; these rights do not establish a separate dwelling.
Check the principal elevation, highway position and the remaining garden coverage before selecting a location.
Within 2m of a boundary, height is limited to 2.5m; within 2m of the house, the limit is 1.5m.
Roof form, protected land and listed-building grounds have additional restrictions.
